_meta.note: Wiki-harvested seed shard. A ring listed here has a ddowiki item page STATING that two copies may be worn toward a set bonus. Absent means NOT duplicable — this list is fail-closed, and silence is never read as permission.
_meta.source: https://ddowiki.com/page/Item:<name>, the `tips` parameter of the Named item Jewelry template
